title.en: Weights within a ratio agree past it
title.zh: 比值之内的权重越过它即一致

statement.en: Every positive weighting whose weights stand within n/d of each other ranks the course keeping p items the other does not above the one keeping q exactly where n q < d p; two such weightings rank a pair opposite ways exactly where n/d exceeds both p/q and q/p.
statement.zh: 权重彼此在 n/d 之内的每个正加权，恰在 n q < d p 时把保住对方所无的 p 项的进程排在保住 q 项者之上；两个这样的加权把一对排成相反方向，恰当 n/d 同时超过 p/q 与 q/p。

laws.en: Where every two listed weights stand within n/d, what each course alone admits bounds what it weighs: d times what the second alone admits weighs, once per item the first alone admits, is at most n times the number the second alone admits, times what the first alone admits weighs.
laws.zh: 所列的每两个权重都在 n/d 之内时，各进程独有者界定其所重：第二条独有者之重的 d 倍，按第一条独有的每项计一次，至多是第二条独有项数的 n 倍乘以第一条独有者之重。

laws.en: Every positive weighting within n/d ranks a above b where n q < d p, and weighs a at least as much where n q ≤ d p, p and q the numbers of items a and b alone admit.
laws.zh: 比值 n/d 之内的每个正加权，在 n q < d p 时把 a 排在 b 之上，在 n q ≤ d p 时给 a 的重量不少于 b，p 与 q 是 a 与 b 各自独有的项数。

laws.en: The weighting tilted toward b, n on what b alone admits and d elsewhere, is positive and within n/d for 0 < d ≤ n; it ranks a above b exactly where n q < d p and ties them on the boundary n q = d p.
laws.zh: 偏向 b 的加权，在 b 独有者上为 n、其余为 d，当 0 < d ≤ n 时为正且在 n/d 之内；它恰在 n q < d p 时把 a 排在 b 之上，并在边界 n q = d p 上使两者持平。

laws.en: For 0 < d ≤ n: every positive weighting within n/d ranks a above b exactly where n q < d p; some ranks b above a exactly where d p < n q; two rank them opposite ways exactly where d q < n p and d p < n q.
laws.zh: 对 0 < d ≤ n：比值 n/d 之内的每个正加权恰在 n q < d p 时把 a 排在 b 之上；某个把 b 排在 a 之上，恰当 d p < n q；两个把它们排成相反方向，恰当 d q < n p 且 d p < n q。

laws.en: Equal weights are the ratio one: under one positive weight a course weighs more exactly where it admits more beyond the other than the other beyond it, so it ranks by number; the weighting tilted toward a course admitting an item the other does not, with weight one more than the listing's length, ranks it higher.
laws.zh: 等权重是比值一：在同一正权重下，一条进程恰在其超出对方者多于对方超出它者时更重，故按数目排；偏向一条接纳了对方所不接纳之项的进程、权重比列举长度多一的加权，把它排得更高。

hypotheses.en: No axiom. A finite listing of items; two-valued admission; natural weights positive on every listed item; the ratio n/d with 0 < d ≤ n for the exact forms (0 < n for the weak one); p and q counted with the listing's repetitions.
hypotheses.zh: 不加公理。项的有限列举；二值接纳；在每个所列项上为正的自然数权重；精确形式需比值 n/d 满足 0 < d ≤ n（弱形式需 0 < n）；p 与 q 按列举中的重复计数。

does_not_show.en: How dispersed actual valuers' weights are, or that their valuations are additive: dispersion is a premise to measure.
does_not_show.zh: 实际评价者的权重分散到什么程度，或其评价可加：分散是要测量的前提。

does_not_show.en: How many valuers disagree: the laws say which weightings can rank a pair opposite ways, not their share; no probability over weights is stated.
does_not_show.zh: 有多少评价者有分歧：这些规律说明哪些加权能把一对排成相反方向，不说其比例；没有陈述权重上的概率。

does_not_show.en: The threshold for orders that are not additive: an order increasing in admission but not additive need not follow it.
does_not_show.zh: 不可加的次序的阈值：随接纳递增但不可加的次序不必遵循它。

does_not_show.en: That the larger side is better: counting is a further premise, and C ranks neither side of a mixed pair.
does_not_show.zh: 较大的一方更好：计数是又一个前提，C 不把混合的一对中任何一方排得更高。

detail.en: On the boundary n q = d p the tilted weighting ties the two courses (Weighting.tilted_ties), and short of it, d p < n q, it ranks the smaller side higher (Weighting.tilted_gt_iff): the threshold is exact.
detail.zh: 在边界 n q = d p 上偏向的加权使两条进程持平（Weighting.tilted_ties），未达边界即 d p < n q 时，它把较小的一方排得更高（Weighting.tilted_gt_iff）：阈值是精确的。

validation_scope.en: Machine-checked by the consolidated Lean 4.29.1 checker (receipt 20261022T143810.042893Z): every declaration of Becoming.Weightings has an empty axiom report, and the checker verifies core purity. The literature check before the Lean is the significance review's valuer-theorems check. Author review in study section 367; not independently reviewed.
validation_scope.zh: Lean 4.29.1 合并检查器实查（回执 20261022T143810.042893Z）：Becoming.Weightings 的每项声明公理报告为空；检查器并核对核心纯净。动手写 Lean 之前的文献核查是显著性审查中的“评价者定理”核查。作者审查见研究第 367 节；未经独立审查。

next_delta.en: A probabilistic form over exchangeable weights, the share of valuers who disagree as a function of dispersion, in the periphery with its axioms reported; the threshold for orders that are not additive; dispersion measured on human valuers; an independent review.
next_delta.zh: 可交换权重上的概率形式，即分歧的评价者所占比例与分散程度的关系，放在外围并报告其公理；不可加次序的阈值；在人类评价者上测分散；独立审查。

correspondence.en: Equal weights and improper linear models (Einhorn and Hogarth 1975; Dawes 1979; Wilks 1938): equal weights approximate estimated ones; here the exact ordinal form for two-valued courses. Dominance under partial information on weights (Kirkwood and Sarin 1985; imprecise ratio statements, Salo and Hämäläinen 1992): the tilted weighting is the extreme point that decides. Robust ordinal regression (Greco, Mousseau and Słowiński 2008): under the ratio bound the necessary relation is n q < d p and a possible reversal d p < n q. Reading (the AI's): "valuers count" (VD1) is weights mostly dispersed less than the pairs' ratios; VD1's mixed pairs kept 2 : 1, 3 : 1 and 1 : 1, so disagreement among valuers whose weights stand within twofold falls only on the last, where it was highest.
correspondence.zh: 等权重与非正规线性模型（Einhorn 与 Hogarth 1975；Dawes 1979；Wilks 1938）：等权重近似估计的权重；此处是二值进程上的精确序数形式。权重部分信息下的占优（Kirkwood 与 Sarin 1985；不精确的比值陈述，Salo 与 Hämäläinen 1992）：偏向的加权是作出裁定的极点。稳健序数回归（Greco、Mousseau 与 Słowiński 2008）：在比值界下，必然关系是 n q < d p，可能的逆转是 d p < n q。解读（AI 的）：“评价者计数”（VD1）是权重大多分散不到各对的比值；VD1 的混合对为 2 : 1、3 : 1 与 1 : 1，所以权重在两倍之内的评价者的分歧只落在最后一种上，那里分歧最高。

比值之内的权重越过它即一致

detail.en: Reuses the weighted count and the comparisons on listed items (Weighting.weighed, IncludesOn, ExceedsOn, WidensOn, total_lt); the widening law there is now this record's case.
detail.zh: 复用所列项上的加权计数与比较（Weighting.weighed、IncludesOn、ExceedsOn、WidensOn、total_lt）；那里的扩大之律现为此处的情形。

output.en: A course and its weighted count over a finite listing.
output.zh: 有限列举上的进程及其加权计数。

input.en: Courses compared by what each admits beyond the other.
input.zh: 按各自超出对方者比较的进程。

detail.en: The other half of the valuer tests as theorems: the exception bounds a widening, this law a mixed comparison.
detail.zh: 评价者检验成为定理的另一半：例外界定扩大，此律界定混合的比较。

history.en: 22 October 2026: added (VT1): the locus VD1 tested, stated as a theorem conditional on how dispersed the weights are, with the exact threshold and the tilted weighting tying at the boundary; outweighs and neutral_ranks_by_number derived as its cases; study section 367.
history.zh: 2026年10月22日：新增（VT1）：VD1 所检验的落点，陈述为以权重分散程度为条件的定理，给出精确阈值，偏向的加权在边界上持平；outweighs 与 neutral_ranks_by_number 作为其情形导出；研究第 367 节。
